PRIVACY POLICY

Your information.
Handled with care.

Last updated October 21, 2026.

Information you provide

Our service request form asks for contact details and project information so R.S. Kohli & Co. can review and respond to your inquiry. Please do not submit passwords, payment information, identity documents, or other sensitive personal details.

Google Forms and response access

The service request opens on Google Forms. Google processes information through its services under its own privacy policies. Responses are reviewed by authorized business users and may be stored in a private linked Google Sheet if configured. They are not published on this website.

How information is used

Information is used to review your project, contact you, and manage related service inquiries. Submitting a project inquiry does not sign you up for marketing communications.

Website and external services

This website has no visitor account or custom intake database. Hosting and asset providers may process technical information to deliver the site. The site loads fonts and the Tailwind browser stylesheet tooling from external providers. No advertising analytics are intentionally added.

Questions about your information

Use the service request form to ask about access to or deletion of information you have submitted. Requests are reviewed by the business, including any applicable recordkeeping obligations.
